description: This PHP class 'ConsoleExceptionListener' handles console command events such as command execution, termination, and errors within the Goteo application. It manages logging, locking, and error notification features for CLI commands.

classes.name: ConsoleExceptionListener
classes.description: Handles console command events, manages logging, locking, and error notifications for CLI commands in the Goteo application.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events this listener subscribes to.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages using the command's logger if available.

methods.name: onCommand
methods.description: Handles the command start event, sets up logging, locking, and command environment.

methods.name: addGlobalOptions
methods.description: Adds global options to the command for logging errors and process locking.

methods.name: addGlobalOptionToSendErrorsByEmail
methods.description: Adds an option to send error logs via email.

methods.name: addGlobalOptionsToLockProcesses
methods.description: Adds options to lock the process to prevent concurrent execution.

methods.name: enableVerboseCommand
methods.description: Enables verbose logging if the verbose option is set.

methods.name: enableNiceColorsIfLoggerIsPresent
methods.description: Configures log formatting with colors and email error notifications if logger is present.

methods.name: onTerminate
methods.description: Handles cleanup after command execution, releases locks, and sends delayed emails.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during command execution, logs error details, and notifies via email if configured.
